race.title: AWC Season 14 Selling Handicap
race.verdict: KALAMUNDA was an unlucky loser last time and can make amends from the same mark to end a lengthy losing run. Tonal looks sure to go close again, while the in-form Gunfighter is another to consider. KALAMUNDA TONAL (FR) GUNFIGHTER (IRE)
